vmCpuPercentOneCore = delta QEMU process CPU seconds / elapsed wall seconds * 100; it can exceed 100. vmCpuPercentWholeMachine divides that result by detected logical processor count.
nvidia-smi reports individual device sensor power only. GPU/NPU Watts are not whole-system or Android-only power. Invoking sensor tools and WMI can affect power and wakeups.

systemPowerWatts is unavailable without a calibrated system power source. Battery dischargeRateRaw is null on AC, while charging, or if unavailable; raw battery units are not converted to Watts because relative-capacity reporting has not been independently excluded.

Application trials force-stop the package and relaunch its resolved activity, preserving its data. Filesystem/ART caches are not cleared; report LaunchState and am timings rather than asserting storage-cold starts.
Diagnostics and optional launch trials occur outside the host observation window. Concurrent host work and guest provisioning are not suppressed.
